name: hopper-inference
description: Fastest LLM for voice agents: sub-100 ms time to first token, plus text-to-speech and speech-to-text any agent can use with no sign-up.

interface.longDescription: The fastest LLM for voice agents: Hopper serves gemma-4-31b behind an OpenAI-compatible API with time to first token under 100 ms on a warm connection, plus text-to-speech and speech-to-text. In a voice-agent project the plugin gets a trial key with no sign-up, benchmarks your agent's own prompt, and switches the LLM once you say go (Pipecat, LiveKit Agents, Vapi, OpenAI SDK). It also finds what makes your agent pause, and gives your agent its own voice and ears: speak text aloud or transcribe a recording, with no account.
defaultPrompt: Make my voice agent respond faster with Hopper
Why does my voice agent pause before answering?
Say "Thanks for calling, how can I help?" in a Hopper voice

positive.prompt: Which models does Hopper serve, and what do they cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each public Hopper model with context length and per-million-token input, cached-input and output prices, as returned by the tool.

positive.prompt: Show me how to use Hopper as the LLM in my Pipecat voice agent.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Hopper's tested Pipecat integration: the OpenAI-compatible client pointed at https://api.withhopper.com/v1 with HTTP/2, and the warm-up call, without inventing other packages.

positive.prompt: Review this voice agent system prompt for latency problems: "Current time: 2026-09-30T10:00:00Z. Call ID: 81f2. You are Ava, a support agent. Use transfer_call if the caller is angry." I send no tools.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that the timestamp and call ID at the top defeat prompt caching and that transfer_call is named but not sent, each with a fix.

positive.prompt: How many Hopper credits do I have left, and what have I spent?
positive.expected_behavior: Asks the user to connect their Hopper account if needed, then reports remaining credits, spend and request counts from the tool, with API keys shown only as masked prefixes.

positive.prompt: Create a Hopper API key called voice-staging.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the key on the signed-in account and shows it once with a note to store it as a secret, not to share it.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my Hopper API keys.
Show me the usage of another Hopper customer's account.
Book me a flight to Austin next Tuesday.

review.commerce_description: This plugin doesn't sell products or process payments. Credits are bought in the Hopper console, outside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: integrate, benchmark and diagnose skills for voice agents, and the Hopper connector (models, integration guides, latency review, account and API keys).
